name: Personalization/Recsys
definition: Building or improving systems that tailor content, offers, or product experiences to individual users, such as recommendation engines and ranking models.

name: Experimentation
definition: Designing and running A/B tests or other controlled experiments to inform product decisions and iterate on features.

name: Agentic/LLM Product
definition: Building products or workflows on large language models, including prompt engineering, tool use, agents, and MCP integrations.

name: Merchant/Marketplace
definition: Owning or growing a platform with multiple sides (merchants, sellers, partners), including onboarding, supply-side tools, and marketplace dynamics.

name: User Research/Discovery
definition: Uncovering user or customer needs through interviews, call analysis, surveys, or observation, and turning findings into product direction.

name: Adoption/Enablement
definition: Driving internal or external uptake of a new tool or product through rollout planning, training, and change management.

name: Lifecycle/CRM
definition: Managing customer communication across the journey (onboarding, engagement, win-back) through channels like push, SMS, email, and in-app messaging.

name: Audience Targeting
definition: Defining segments and deciding who receives which message, offer, or experience, based on behavior or attributes.

name: Paid/Performance
definition: Managing paid acquisition or ad placements against efficiency metrics such as CAC, CTR, CVR, and ROAS.

name: Partnerships/Co-marketing
definition: Running joint campaigns or promotions with external brands or partners for mutual audience or revenue benefit.

name: Positioning/Messaging
definition: Defining how a product is framed, who it's for, and what story is told, including launch narratives and value propositions.

name: Enterprise AI Deployment
definition: Taking AI from concept to production inside a large or risk-averse organization, including stakeholder alignment, integration, and governance.

name: Business Case/Exec Comms
definition: Building the quantified argument for an initiative and presenting results or recommendations to senior leadership.

name: Partner/Vendor Management
definition: Selecting, managing, and getting results from external vendors or technology partners.

name: Workflow Automation
definition: Redesigning or automating manual processes to cut cycle time or cost.

name: Pilot-to-Scale
definition: Proving an idea with a limited pilot, then expanding it into a repeatable, larger rollout.

name: Lifecycle/Funnel Analytics
definition: Analyzing user progression and behavior over time, including cohorts, churn, funnel drop-off, and lifetime value.

name: Experiment Design/Causal Inference
definition: Establishing whether an intervention caused an outcome through test design, holdouts, incrementality, and statistical rigor.

name: Predictive Modeling
definition: Building statistical or machine learning models to forecast outcomes or score users, such as propensity, churn, or demand.

name: Measurement/Attribution
definition: Defining metrics and methods to quantify the impact and ROI of campaigns, features, or programs.

name: BI/Dashboarding
definition: Building reporting and visualization layers that let stakeholders track performance and self-serve insights.

name: Data Infrastructure
definition: Designing the pipelines, models, and platforms that make data accessible and reliable, including SQL, warehousing, and ETL.
